stem.text: A beam of electrons is directed into an electric field and is deflected by it.
Diagram 1 represents an electric field in the plane of the paper.
Diagram 2 represents an electric field directed perpendicular to the plane of the paper.
The lines **A**, **B**, **C** and **D** represent possible paths of the electron beam. All paths are in the plane of the paper.
Which line best represents the path of the electrons inside the field?

stem.alt: Diagram 1: electron beam entering from below a region of horizontal arrowed field lines pointing left, with two curved paths labelled A and B; labelled electric field in the plane of the paper and electrons.

Diagram 2: electron beam entering from below a shaded rectangular region, with two curved paths labelled C and D; labelled electric field into the paper and perpendicular to the plane of the paper, and electrons.
